topic: How does the stock market work?
title: How Does the Stock Market Work? (Explained Like You're 5)
description: What is a share? Why do prices go up and down? Mia and her lemonade stand explain the stock market in two minutes.

props.question: How does the stock market work?

lines.text: Hi friend! Today we're going to learn about the stock market.
It sounds big and grown-up, but it's really simple.
Let's find out... with lemonade!
This is Mia.
Mia has a little lemonade stand.
Every day she sells yummy lemonade, and people give her coins.
Mia wants a bigger stand, with more lemons and a big, shiny sign.
But that costs lots of coins,
and Mia doesn't have enough.
So Mia has an idea!
She pretends her lemonade stand is a big pizza,
and she cuts it into ten slices.
Each slice is called a share.
Mia's friends buy the slices.
Leo buys one.
Zoe buys one. Soon every slice is sold!
Now Mia has enough coins to build her big new stand!
And her friends each own a tiny piece of it.
The new stand is a big hit! Lots of people want lemonade.
Now everybody wants a slice of Mia's stand.
When lots of people want something, its price goes up!
Leo's slice used to cost one coin.
Now it costs three!
But some days, it rains, and fewer people buy lemonade.
So fewer people want a slice, and the price goes down.
Up and down, up and down, like a bouncy ball!
Now imagine a giant playground with lots and lots of shops.
Toy shops, cookie shops, and even phone companies! They all have slices too.
People come here to buy slices, and sell slices.
This big playground is called... the stock market!
So let's remember!
A company is like a lemonade stand.
A share is one slice.
And the stock market is where people buy and sell slices.
Great job today, friend! See you next time!
